title: Dream Psychology
author: Sigmund Freud
description: Freud’s own condensed introduction to dream interpretation, written for people who were never going to read the eight-hundred-page version.
snippet: The medical profession is justly conservative. Human life should not be considered as the proper material for wild experiments.
